236.neglected: Nothing rests on it. Still unchecked.

360.carried:
It remembers where you pushed. It smiled
the whole time.
360.neglected: Nobody has pushed. It is still smiling.

340.carried: You gave it something else to read.
340.neglected: Left alone. Drawing from its own drawings.

181.neglected: All of it still held. No moment yet.

173.carried: It was in every reading of yours too.
173.neglected: Still in everything. Still no use.

186.carried:
It let you through. It did not care which
of you it was.
186.neglected: Nothing passing. It is still counting.

174.carried:
You woke it a great many times. It cost
less each time.

172.carried: You found out by touching it.
172.neglected: Still holding it. Nobody has touched it.

238.carried:
You read it every time. It still does not
know.
238.neglected:
Nothing to give away. It is giving it
away.

195.carried:
It arrived everywhere you did, and meant
all of it.
195.neglected:
No current. It has arrived nowhere, and
means that too.

350.carried:
The tail was toward you. The rest
followed.
350.neglected:
Neither toward nor away. The tail has not
decided.

205.carried: It has not opened for you either.
205.neglected: Still sealed. Still from the inside.

152.carried:
You decided what it met, and in what
order. It has not been surprised yet.
152.neglected:
It is still on the first thing it was given.
Nobody has made it harder.
152.instinctCarried:
It took everything you gave it calmly.
You were careful what you gave it.
152.instinctNeglected:
It is comfortable. It has been
comfortable a long time.

153.carried:
You have kept to its order. You have not
asked about the last one either.
153.neglected:
Its row is laid out. Nobody has come to
start it.
153.instinctCarried:
It liked knowing what came next. So did
you.
153.instinctNeglected:
It is still waiting for the next thing in
the row.

154.carried:
It has been through everything you set in
front of it. You set all of it.
154.neglected:
Its scent still calms the box. Nobody in
there is learning anything.
154.instinctCarried:
Beside it, everything felt ready to be
learned. It was.
154.instinctNeglected:
It is calm. Nothing near it is being
learned.

155.carried:
It has wandered off your path a few
times. You let it.
155.neglected:
Cooling. Its choices have stopped
wandering.
155.instinctCarried:
You never knew which way it would go.
You liked that.
155.instinctNeglected:
It has gone cold enough to be
predictable.

156.carried:
You have turned it up often. It has not
settled on anything yet.
156.neglected:
Its flames are low. Every answer is still
in there, waiting.
156.instinctCarried:
Beside it you felt hurried, in every
direction at once.
156.instinctNeglected: It is still undecided. Slowly now.

157.carried:
You have taken it everywhere. It has
made everywhere the same.
157.neglected:
Shut away, it is still warm. Everything
near it has evened out.
157.instinctCarried:
Every place felt the same beside it. You
kept going anyway.
157.instinctNeglected:
It is very calm in there. So is everything
else.

158.carried:
It has been wrong in front of you many
times. Each time it changed a little less.
158.neglected:
It has not been wrong in a while. It has
not changed either.
158.instinctCarried:
Its first bites were too hard. It learned
how hard you could take.
158.instinctNeglected:
It is hungry, and not sure how hard to
bite.

159.carried:
It has carried you over a few dips you
would have stopped at.
159.neglected:
Stopped. The next small dip will be
enough to keep it there.
159.instinctCarried:
It never stopped to check. Some days you
did not either.
159.instinctNeglected:
Still. Starting again will take more than
it did.

160.carried:
It took you down the fastest way every
time. You have not looked over the next
ridge.
160.neglected:
It has settled in the nearest low place.
It is sure of it.
160.instinctCarried:
It always felt like arriving. It was
always the nearest place.
160.instinctNeglected:
It is sure it is where it should be.
Nobody has said otherwise.

277.carried:
You keep asking it. It keeps being a
little right.
277.instinctCarried:
You leaned on it more than its one
question deserved. It held.
277.instinctNeglected:
It is still asking above or below. Nobody
needs the answer.

278.carried:
Its leaves are thick now. You know where
each one grew.
278.neglected:
No new leaves. Nothing has been wrong
near it.
278.instinctCarried:
It kept fixing what the last one missed.
You never had to ask.
278.instinctNeglected:
It is still waiting to be told it was
enough.

279.carried:
You have trusted its answer more than any
one of its trees.
279.neglected:
The wood is still deciding things. Nobody
comes to ask.
279.instinctCarried:
It always seemed to know. No part of it
did.
279.instinctNeglected: Quiet in there, the way a wood is quiet.

280.carried:
You have followed it either way. It has
not pretended once.
280.neglected:
Nothing to decide. It is still not
pretending.
280.instinctCarried: You trusted it more than the sure ones.
280.instinctNeglected:
Heads or tails. Nobody has asked it to
land.

281.carried:
It has been close every time you asked.
You have not checked how close.
281.neglected:
No guesses. It is not even close to
anything.
281.instinctCarried:
It was always nearly right. Nearly felt
like enough.
281.instinctNeglected:
It is still counting something nobody
asked about.

282.carried:
You have waited for it every time. It has
not been wrong yet.
282.neglected:
It is still rolling for something. Nobody
is waiting on the answer.
282.instinctCarried:
Waiting on it was hard. Being sure was
worth it, most days.
282.instinctNeglected: Somewhere in there, it is still rolling.

283.carried:
It has run down every hill you took it
over. They are all a little lower.
283.neglected:
No rain. It has taken nothing from anyone
in a while.
283.instinctCarried:
Everywhere it went, it took a little with
it. You did not notice either.
283.instinctNeglected:
Dry. The hillside has stopped losing
anything.

284.carried:
There is a layer for each of your fights
now, the first one deepest.
284.neglected:
Nothing new has settled on it since you
put it down.
284.instinctCarried:
Dig into it and you would find yourself,
in order.
284.instinctNeglected: Its top layer is the day you left it.

285.carried:
It is closer to where you wanted it than
it has ever been. It has not arrived.
285.neglected:
Nobody is telling it where to be. It has
stopped correcting.
285.instinctCarried:
It never arrived anywhere with you. It
was always close.
285.instinctNeglected:
It is still spreading toward somewhere it
was once told to go.

309.carried:
It took you wherever the ground tipped.
You did not look further either.
309.neglected:
Nothing slopes in there. It does not know
which way to go.
309.instinctCarried:
It always seemed to know the way. Only
ever the next bit of it.
309.instinctNeglected: It is facing whichever way it last tipped.

310.carried:
It has handed you every way there was.
You have chosen each time.
310.neglected: Its bill is still full. Nobody is choosing.
310.instinctCarried:
It always brought too much. You never
minded choosing.
310.instinctNeglected:
It is holding every direction, and going
none of them.

330.carried:
You are further from where you started
than you meant to be.
330.neglected: Nothing near it has drifted in a while.
330.instinctCarried:
You felt it pulling, a little, all the
way. You went anyway.
330.instinctNeglected: Still water. It is still under it.

331.carried:
It has carried you out more than once.
You have always found the side.
331.neglected:
It is still pulling at nothing, straight
out.
331.instinctCarried:
It took you out further than you liked.
You came back each time, some other way.

328.carried:
You have kept it when you did not have
to.
328.instinctCarried:
You never thought it was plain. Or you
did, and stayed.
328.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting for the right way to be
pushed.

329.neglected:
It is resting at its lowest. Nothing in
there needs to move.
329.instinctCarried:
You remember what it looked like before.
It does too.
329.instinctNeglected:
Calm. It is still the most beautiful thing
in there.

323.carried:
It has come up beside you in every place
you went.
323.neglected:
Gone from underfoot. Something feels
drier.
323.instinctCarried:
It felt the ground shift before you did.
You started trusting that.
323.instinctNeglected:
Somewhere under the floor, it is still
soaking down.

324.carried:
It has taken in everything you walked it
through. It has kept all of it.
324.neglected:
It is holding its lake still. Nothing is
drawing from it.
324.instinctCarried:
It remembers every rain you walked
through together.
324.instinctNeglected:
Deep, and quiet. It remembers the last
rain.

326.carried:
It has gone against you a few times. It
has not let go.
326.neglected:
It is gripping the box. Nothing else is in
its stream.
326.instinctCarried:
It held on through all of it, the wrong
way round.

327.carried:
You have carried it a long way. You have
never seen what it was doing.
327.neglected:
Dark in there. It has grown harder
anyway.
327.instinctCarried:
You never saw into it. It never seemed to
mind.
327.instinctNeglected: The water around it has not cleared.

295.carried:
It kept to its step the whole way. You
learned to wait for it.
295.neglected:
No current. It has not taken a step in a
long time.
295.instinctCarried:
You walked a little slower with it. It
never asked you to.
295.instinctNeglected: It is still keeping time to something.

296.carried:
It slowed down every time it was close.
You started to notice when it was close.
296.neglected:
Its steps have stopped. It was nowhere
near anything.
296.instinctCarried:
It always slowed before you knew you
were close.
296.instinctNeglected:
It is between steps, and not sure how big
the next should be.

297.carried:
You have been moving with it for some
time. You did not decide to.
297.neglected:
The dance has stopped. It settled where
it was.
297.instinctCarried:
You caught yourself keeping time to it
more than once.
297.instinctNeglected:
It is still swaying a little, to something
nobody else can hear.

311.carried:
You have carried one. It has been looking
for the others the whole time.
311.neglected:
Alone in there, it is still pulled toward
the best spot it ever found.
311.instinctCarried:
It never knew the best place. With you it
did not seem to need to.
311.instinctNeglected:
It is skating in circles, waiting for the
rest.

312.carried:
It has kept close, never collided, and
gone where you went.
312.neglected:
Nobody to keep close to. Its wings are
still watching.
312.instinctCarried:
You turned together often. Neither of you
remembers who turned first.
312.instinctNeglected:
Its wings are open, watching for a flock
that is not there.

222.carried:
It has grown a great deal with you.
Nobody has joined it back to anything.
222.neglected:
It is still growing in there, on its own.
Nobody is watching how.
222.instinctCarried:
It broke a few times along the way. It
grew back each time.

373.carried:
It has stayed shut the whole way with
you. It is still holding the one pearl.
373.neglected:
Shut. Whatever it is holding has not
changed.
373.instinctCarried:
It could have become either. With you, it
never seemed to mind which.
373.instinctNeglected: Still closed around the one thing.

374.carried: It has travelled with you anyway.
374.neglected:
It is deep in there, and nothing is
nudging it.
374.instinctCarried:
It never liked being moved. You moved it
everywhere, gently.
374.instinctNeglected:
Lowest thing in the box. Nothing has
nudged it.

375.carried:
You have pushed it every way there is. It
has stayed almost exactly where it was.
375.neglected:
Still there. The water has not changed
yet.
375.instinctCarried:
It never seemed to mind where you took
it. It was always about the same.
375.instinctNeglected:
It is resting, as low as it ever needed to
be.

325.carried:
You have been drifting the same way for a
long time now.
325.neglected:
It is drifting, and nothing is drifting
beside it.
325.instinctCarried:
By now nobody could say which of you was
going which way.
325.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting where two currents would
meet.

381.carried:
It has kept running the whole time you
carried it. You have not switched it off
either.
381.neglected:
Still running. Nobody remembers why it was
left on.
381.instinctCarried: You felt older beside it. Steadier too.
381.instinctNeglected: It has not stopped. It does not know how.

342.carried:
You have taught it a great deal. None of
it has gone back through.
342.neglected:
It is held still. Nothing has tried to
change it.
342.instinctCarried:
It took everything you gave it and
changed nothing. You did not mind.
342.instinctNeglected: Cold and still, exactly as it was left.

343.carried:
It still remembers the way you fought at
first.
343.neglected: Frozen exactly as you left it.
343.instinctCarried:
Something in it is still how you were when
you met.
343.instinctNeglected:
It is keeping something for you. It may
not be true any more.

332.carried:
You have carried it everywhere. It has
never once had to chase anything.
332.neglected:
Its pit is still dug. Nothing has come
near the edge.
332.instinctCarried:
Things came to you more easily with it
near. You stopped wondering why.
332.instinctNeglected: It is waiting at the bottom of something.

333.carried:
It has gone up whenever the ground was
warm. You have learned when that is.
333.instinctCarried:
It never seemed to work at flying. Some
days with you it just rose.
333.instinctNeglected:
It is resting on cold ground, waiting for
the warm.

334.carried:
It has come apart in front of you more
than once. Each time, something like it
came back.
334.neglected: No wind. It has not formed in a while.
334.instinctCarried:
You never steered it. It went where you
were going anyway.
334.instinctNeglected:
Somewhere in there, sand is waiting for
the right afternoon.

358.carried:
It has delivered everything you gave it.
It has not opened one.
358.neglected:
Its bundle is still tied on. Nobody has
written where.
358.instinctCarried:
It never asked what it was carrying for
you. You never told it.
358.instinctNeglected:
It is holding something for someone. It
does not know who.

359.carried:
You have trusted its heading more than
your map.
359.neglected:
It is still blowing the same way. Nothing
is riding along.
359.instinctCarried:
It always felt like being carried the
right way.
359.instinctNeglected: Steady, and going nowhere you are.

395.carried:
It has butted every rock you passed. It
still cannot say what for.
395.neglected:
Its head is down. It is still sure of
something.
395.instinctCarried:
It was sure of something the whole time.
So, somehow, were you.
395.instinctNeglected:
It is not ready yet. It is still sure it
will be.

396.carried:
You have carried the shell everywhere.
You have not seen what is inside it.
396.neglected: Still shut. The parts are still parts.
396.instinctCarried:
You felt something taking shape in there.
You did not open it to check.
396.instinctNeglected:
Shut, and very still. Something is not
finished.

397.carried:
You did not see it learn to fly. You were
there.
397.neglected:
It knows how to fly. Nothing has asked it
to.
397.instinctCarried:
It arrived all at once. You knew it would
before it did.
397.instinctNeglected:
It is pointing at something. Nobody is
looking where.

388.carried:
You woke it, and it carried on as if you
had always been there.
388.neglected:
Put back in the dark. It will carry on
from here, whenever that is.
388.instinctCarried:
It still reaches for a sea that is not
there. It reaches toward you as well.
388.instinctNeglected: It is stopped, exactly where it was.

389.carried:
It has learned a great deal from you, on
top of everything it already knew.
389.neglected:
It has stopped fitting itself to anything
new.
389.instinctCarried:
Everything you showed it went on top.
None of the old went away.
389.instinctNeglected:
Still growing toward the water it
remembers.

390.carried:
It has waited its turn every time. You
have not hurried it.
390.neglected: Nobody is passing it the token.
390.instinctCarried: Being with it felt slow, and fair.
390.instinctNeglected: It is holding still. It is not its turn.

391.carried:
Everything you did went along it. You
have not switched it off.
391.neglected:
It is still carrying messages in there.
Nobody remembers sending them.
391.instinctCarried:
You leaned on it without noticing. It did
not mind.
391.instinctNeglected:
Still on. Still carrying something for
everyone.

286.carried:
Everything you have walked it past is a
little harder to read now.
286.neglected: Nothing has been smudged in a while.
286.instinctCarried:
Things got a little blurrier with it
around. You did not mind.
286.instinctNeglected:
It is rubbing against the walls of the
box.

287.carried:
You know its shape very well by now. That
is all you know.
287.instinctCarried:
You never saw past it. You stopped
trying.
287.instinctNeglected:
In the dark it is only a shape. It was
only a shape before.

288.carried:
It has taken you off every path you were
on. You came back with something each
time.
288.neglected:
It is not wandering. It has nothing to
bring back.
288.instinctCarried:
You were lost with it more than once. It
never was.
288.instinctNeglected:
It is sniffing at the corners, looking for
a path.

289.carried:
It has run straight ahead every time you
let it. You have let it more and more.
289.neglected:
It has stopped. It does not know how to
turn.
289.instinctCarried:
It never asked where you were going. It
just went.
289.instinctNeglected: Still pointed straight ahead, at the wall.

298.carried:
It has practised the same small things
with you every day. It is quicker at them
now.
298.neglected:
It has stopped practising. Nothing is
getting quicker.
298.instinctCarried:
It was slow at first. You were patient. It
noticed.
298.instinctNeglected: It is hanging from something, very still.

299.carried:
It has learned what you pay for. It does
a little more of it each time.
299.neglected:
Nothing is being paid for. It is still
looking.
299.instinctCarried:
It always seemed to know what would
please you, before you knew you had
shown it.
299.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting for something to be worth
doing.

300.carried:
It does things your way now. It could not
tell you why.
300.neglected:
It has kept its one way, with nothing to
do it to.
300.instinctCarried:
It settled into your ways quickly. You did
not know you had any.
300.instinctNeglected:
Same way, every wind. There is no wind in
there.

304.carried: You have gone a long way in short hops.
304.neglected:
It is perched. The next place is out of
sight.
304.instinctCarried:
Every hop with it felt safe. They were
all small.
304.instinctNeglected:
It can see nothing near enough to land
on.

305.carried:
It has gone a long way with you. It still
knows where you started.
305.neglected:
It is home. It is waiting to be somewhere
else.
305.instinctCarried:
Wherever it took you, you never felt far
from home.
305.instinctNeglected: It is still facing the way home.

306.carried:
It has lost in front of you more than
once. It kept every one.
306.neglected:
Nothing to box. It is not losing, or
getting better.
306.instinctCarried:
It never minded losing with you. You
minded less, after a while.
306.instinctNeglected: It is shadowboxing in the dark.

307.carried:
You have stopped watching how its fights
end. You already know.
307.neglected:
Nowhere left to stand in there. Nothing is
standing.
307.instinctCarried:
You always knew how it would end, a
little before it did.
307.instinctNeglected:
Still. It has already worked out how this
ends.

370.carried:
You have heard it, even when it was
quiet.
370.neglected: Too quiet in there to hear.
370.instinctCarried:
It was always the small sound under
everything else.
370.instinctNeglected: It is whispering. Nothing is listening.

371.carried:
It was quiet when you met. You could
count from there.
371.neglected:
It has stopped doubling. It is still very
loud in there.
371.instinctCarried:
It got louder every day with you. You
got used to it every day.

372.carried:
You have heard it at its loudest. It
sounded like a whisper.
372.neglected:
Its roar is very quiet now. That is not
the same as quiet.
372.instinctCarried:
You learned to listen for the whisper. It
was the loudest it could be.
372.instinctNeglected:
Somewhere in there, it is starting again
from nothing.

315.carried:
It has called out the whole time you
carried it. You have answered once or
twice.
315.neglected: It is chasing its tail. It is not lonely.
315.instinctCarried:
It never needed you to answer. You did
anyway.
315.instinctNeglected: Round and round. It does not need anyone.

316.carried:
It has told you exactly what it is many
times. You have not asked anything else.
316.neglected: It is describing itself to nobody.
316.instinctCarried:
You always knew exactly what it was. That
was a comfort.
316.instinctNeglected:
It is saying what it is, over and over,
very quietly.

363.carried:
You have learned a lot beside it. You do
not know what else.
363.neglected: Nothing is learning from it in there.
363.instinctCarried:
It always smelled sweet. You never asked
what else was on it.
363.instinctNeglected: It is waiting for one particular moment.

386.carried:
It has asked you every night. You have
answered every time.
386.neglected:
It flashed once, a long time ago. It is
still waiting.
386.instinctCarried:
It felt good to be answered. It felt good
to answer it.
386.instinctNeglected: One flash, in the dark, a long time ago.

387.carried:
It has answered everything you asked. You
blink together now.
387.neglected:
Nothing to answer in there. It is keeping
time anyway.
387.instinctCarried:
Somewhere along the way you started
keeping the same time.
387.instinctNeglected: It is answering a flash nobody sent.

207.carried:
It has come down with you from every
height. It always meant where.
207.neglected:
It is on the ground. There is no cliff in
there.
207.instinctCarried:
It never went up with you. It was always
sure of the way down.
207.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting for somewhere high enough to
come down from.

335.carried:
You have built a lot on it. You have not
asked why it stands there.
335.neglected:
It is standing where it was put. Nothing is
being built on it.
335.instinctCarried: You leaned on it without asking. It held.
335.instinctNeglected:
Feet planted. It is still taking it as
given.

336.carried: You have stopped checking its steps.
336.neglected:
Its last step was a long time ago. The
next one still follows from it.
336.instinctCarried:
Every fight with it went one way. You
could feel it going there.
336.instinctNeglected:
It is standing on its last step, waiting
for the next.

322.carried:
It has been with you all along. You have
looked straight at it.
322.neglected: Its eyes are still shining in there.
322.instinctCarried: You always felt it before you saw it.
322.instinctNeglected:
It is somewhere in there, under
everything.

355.carried: You have watched it look easy many times.
355.neglected:
It is lying very still, with something
sweet inside.
355.instinctCarried:
It always looked like the easy way in.
You never fell for it.
355.instinctNeglected: Still open. Nothing has come near.

382.carried:
Every fight you have had with it began
the same way.
382.neglected:
It has not been started in a long time. It
will start the same way.
382.instinctCarried:
Everything with it began the same way.
That steadied you.
382.instinctNeglected:
Small and hard, waiting to be the first
thing.

383.carried: You have not changed it. It still works.
383.neglected:
Nobody has dared to touch it. It has not
been asked to work.
383.instinctCarried: It felt finished the day you met it.
383.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting for an update nobody is
going to send.

384.carried: You have not replaced it either.
384.neglected:
Put away, which is not the same as
replaced.
384.instinctCarried:
Everything rested on it. You did not have
to think about that.
384.instinctNeglected: Old, and very still, and not broken.

337.carried:
You have felt it before you heard it many
times now.
337.neglected: Its fur is flat. Nothing is building up.
337.instinctCarried:
Your hands always tingled after. You
stopped noticing.

338.carried:
You have stopped flinching at the
thunder. It always came after.
338.neglected:
The charge is building in there. There is
no gap to jump.
338.instinctCarried:
It struck before you were ready, every
time. You came to like that.
338.instinctNeglected: The air near it still smells faintly burnt.

353.carried:
It has given you a great deal. It is still
looking for its other half.
353.neglected: On its own, it is doing nothing.
353.instinctCarried:
It was always happiest when it was not
alone.
353.instinctNeglected: It is giving off charge to nobody.

354.carried:
It has taken in everything you gave it. It
was not the lesser one.
354.instinctCarried:
Something flowed between you. Neither of
you made it alone.
354.instinctNeglected: It is waiting for its other half.

321.carried:
Everything you carry beside it is a little
grey now.
321.neglected:
Still burning, low. The box is getting
smoky.
321.instinctCarried: It never went out on you. Not once.
321.instinctNeglected: Low, and steady, and not out.

308.carried:
You could pick it out of any crowd now,
by its spots alone.
308.neglected:
Its spots are exactly as they were. So is
everything else.
308.instinctCarried:
You knew it by its spots from the first
day.
308.instinctNeglected: Nobody is looking at its spots.

344.carried:
You did not have to show it much. It kept
all of it.
344.neglected:
It is living on the last thing you showed
it.
344.instinctCarried:
It never needed much from you. It took it
gladly.
344.instinctNeglected: One rain. It is still living on it.

345.carried:
It does things you never showed it. You
have stopped asking where from.
345.neglected:
It is doing something in there, at night.
Nobody showed it how.
345.instinctCarried:
It knew what to do before you did, more
than once.
345.instinctNeglected: Sure of something nobody taught it.

380.carried:
It is exactly as it was when you met. It
looked at you once, and decided.
380.neglected:
Nothing added, nothing missing, nothing
happening.
380.instinctCarried:
It looked straight at you once and knew.
It has not looked again.
380.instinctNeglected: It is watching for its one enemy.

379.carried:
It has copied a great deal of you by
now. You have not found the change.
379.neglected: It is copying the walls of the box.
379.instinctCarried:
Something about it was always a little
off. You liked it anyway.
379.instinctNeglected: It is practising its signature in the dark.

348.carried:
It has read everything you did from the
small end first. It got the same answer.
348.neglected: It is reading nothing, small end first.
348.instinctCarried:
It always started with the little things.
So, with it, did you.
348.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting for its other half to read
the other end.

349.carried:
It has read everything you did from the
big end first. It got the same answer.
349.neglected: It is reading nothing, big end first.
349.instinctCarried:
It always started with the big things. You
were glad of that, some days.
349.instinctNeglected:
Still arguing, with nobody, about which
end comes first.

369.carried:
What it learned with you in one place has
been good in the next.
369.neglected:
It is carrying fruit from somewhere far
away. Nobody is eating it.
369.instinctCarried:
It always brought something from the last
place. It was always welcome.
369.instinctNeglected:
It is still ripening something from far
away.

411.carried:
You hear something different in it now. It
is the same note.
411.neglected:
It is ringing. Nobody is standing anywhere
near it.
411.instinctCarried:
Its note sounded different every place
you stood.
411.instinctNeglected:
One note, still the same. Nobody to hear
it differently.

376.carried:
It has come before every hard fight you
have had. You have not blamed it.
376.neglected:
It is in there, with something to tell.
Every word is blacked out.
376.instinctCarried:
You always felt it was trying to tell you
something.
376.instinctNeglected:
It knows what is coming. It is waiting for
someone to tell.

346.carried:
It has held every door you asked it to.
You have come back for it each time.
346.neglected:
It is still sitting where you left it.
Nobody has come to let it go.
346.instinctCarried:
It never moved from where you put it.
You never had to wonder.
346.instinctNeglected:
Still sitting in front of something. It was
only meant to be a moment.

347.carried:
You have never once waited for it to move
first.
347.neglected:
In there, it is waiting for something that
is waiting for it.
347.instinctCarried:
With you, something always moved first. It
was usually you.
347.instinctNeglected:
Nothing is broken in there. Nothing is
moving either.

404.carried:
You have poured a great deal into it.
None of it has kept its edge.
404.neglected: Everything that fell into it is still in it.
404.instinctCarried:
Beside it, you were never sure where you
stopped.
404.instinctNeglected:
Deep, and without a shape. It does not
need one.

405.carried:
You have stood on it for a long time.
Your map has changed.
405.neglected: Asleep. The maps are holding, for now.
405.instinctCarried:
Everything felt steadier with it under
you.
405.instinctNeglected: It is shifting a little, in its sleep.

406.carried:
It came down when you needed it. It has
not taken your side either.
406.neglected:
It is above everything in there. Nothing
below it is fighting.
406.instinctCarried:
When it was near, the arguing stopped.
Yours too.
406.instinctNeglected: High above the box, saying nothing.

245.carried:
Everywhere you have taken it is a little
clearer.
245.neglected:
It is standing on still water. Nothing is
being cleared.
245.instinctCarried:
You felt clearer after it passed. You
could not have said why.
245.instinctNeglected: The surface it rests on has not broken.

243.carried:
You stopped waiting for the crack. You
knew from the light.
243.instinctCarried:
Your heart jumped every time. It never
stopped jumping.
243.instinctNeglected: It is the quiet after something.

244.carried:
You have carried it everywhere. It has
not gone out.
244.instinctCarried:
It was always warmer near it than you
expected.
244.instinctNeglected:
Somewhere under everything, it is still
burning.

403.carried:
It has walked every round you gave it. It
walks them for you now.
403.neglected:
It is still walking its rounds in there.
Nobody remembers setting them.
403.instinctCarried:
It felt like being guarded by someone who
would never leave.
403.instinctNeglected: It is guarding a gate nobody comes to.

401.carried:
It has been beside you a long time. It is
still not sure what it is.
401.neglected: It is lying down again, like a stone.
401.instinctCarried:
It was never sure what it was. With you it
did not seem to matter.
401.instinctNeglected:
Still made of the mountain. Still not the
mountain.

402.carried:
It remembers every fight you have had,
exactly. It has not learned from one.
402.neglected: Nothing new has fallen into it.
402.instinctCarried:
It kept everything you gave it, exactly
as it was. Even the parts you would have
let go.
402.instinctNeglected: Clear, and cold, and keeping everything.

408.carried:
Everything you have shown it, somewhere,
its twin has seen.
408.neglected:
It is seeing the inside of the box. So,
somewhere, is its twin.
408.instinctCarried:
It was never alone with you. Its twin was
always there too.
408.instinctNeglected: It is waiting for its twin to come.

407.carried:
It has given you a great deal. It has
given away half of everything before.
407.neglected:
It is feeling what its twin feels, from in
there.
407.instinctCarried:
It came to you without being called, more
than once.
407.instinctNeglected:
It has given half of everything. It does
not think that unfair.

251.carried: You reached at the right moment.
251.neglected:
You reached in time. Then you put it
away.
251.instinctCarried:
You felt the moment before it came. You
were ready.
251.instinctNeglected:
The moment it was there for has passed.
It stayed anyway.

409.carried:
It has been awake for you longer than it
should be. It is still listening.
409.neglected:
Asleep at the bottom of something. Still
there.
409.instinctCarried:
It listened to everything. You said more
than you meant to.
409.instinctNeglected: Everything else got out. It is still here.

253.carried:
You have looked into the mirror it
carries. You looked for a long time.
253.neglected:
It is still holding the mirror out. Nobody
has taken it.

254.carried:
You have walked a long way by its light.
You have not once looked lost.
254.neglected:
It is still shining where it was left.
Somebody, somewhere, is walking toward it.

255.carried:
It has stayed close to you a long while
now. That is not like it.
255.neglected: It has gone round again. It will be back.

256.neglected: It came all this way. You put it away.

257.carried: You did not walk away from this one.
257.neglected:
You walked away. It understands. Its
light is still on.

258.carried: You stayed until it was all light.
258.neglected: Even put away, it is not dark in there.

259.carried: It follows you from room to room now.
259.neglected: It is waiting by the door.

260.carried:
You have made more since you started
carrying it.
260.neglected:
It is sitting very still. It is waiting for
you to begin.
